records.text: Owens said Howard Hughes shut RKO down for six months in 1948 to investigate every employee political leaning.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Now, he was so paranoid. This is a fact. fact that he shut down his film studio after he acquired it, RKO, for six months he shut it down to investigate the political leanings of every single employee.

verification.notes: Film-history references consistently report that after taking control of RKO in 1948, Hughes virtually halted production for six months while remaining employees' political views were investigated.
